web.description: Enter the address of your Nextcloud server and an **app password** (Settings, Security, Devices & sessions). The Cospend app must be installed.

local.title: Local IP address and port
local.description: Reach Nextcloud directly on your local network, without depending on a domain name or a reverse proxy. Use an **app password** (Settings, Security, Devices & sessions). The IP address must be listed in the `trusted_domains` of Nextcloud.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.20. Do not type the protocol or the port here.
data_description.port: Port of Nextcloud on that machine (80 for http, 443 for https, or the port you published).
data_description.ssl: Tick only if the server answers in HTTPS on this port.
data_description.password: Create a dedicated app password in Nextcloud; do not use your main password.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable for a self-signed certificate. Only used with HTTPS.

init.title: Cospend options
init.description: Choose the projects to follow and how often to read them.

data_description.scan_interval: Only bills changed since the last read are fetched at each refresh.
data_description.full_resync_hours: Re-reads every bill from time to time to catch silent changes.

add_bill.name: Add a bill
add_bill.description: Records a new expense in a Cospend project. A custom split (amounts or percentages) creates one bill per participant, like the Cowspent app. If Cospend cannot be reached, the operation is queued and sent later (the response has queued: true).

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: A number or a calculation such as 12,5 + 7.

owers.name: Participants
owers.description: Members who share the expense. All active members when empty.

split_mode.name: Split
split_mode.description: Even split, fixed amounts or percentages.

shares.name: Shares
shares.description: Amount or percentage per member, e.g. Alice 60 and Bob 40. Required unless the split is even.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the expense. Today, now, when empty.

currency.name: Currency
currency.description: Foreign currency code. The amount is converted with the exchange rate.

exchange_rate.name: Exchange rate
exchange_rate.description: Value of one unit of the foreign currency in the project currency. Taken from the project when empty.

repeat_frequency.name: Repeat every
repeat_frequency.description: Number of periods between two occurrences.

repeat_all_active.name: All active members
repeat_all_active.description: Include the members added later in the recurrence.

update_bill.name: Update a bill
update_bill.description: Changes some fields of an existing expense. Only the fields you provide are changed. The amount, the currency and the participants of a custom-split expense cannot be changed. If Cospend is unreachable, the operation is queued and sent later.

bill_id.name: Bill identifier
bill_id.description: Identifier of the bill (or of any bill of a custom-split group).

currency.name: Currency
currency.description: Code of the foreign currency; needs the amount, which is then the amount in that currency. Without it, the amount is in the project currency.

exchange_rate.name: Exchange rate
exchange_rate.description: Value of one unit of the foreign currency in the project currency. Taken from the project when empty.

repeat_frequency.name: Repeat every
repeat_frequency.description: Number of periods between two occurrences.

repeat_until.name: Repeat until
repeat_until.description: Last day of the recurrence (AAAA-MM-JJ). Leave empty text to remove the end date.

repeat_all_active.name: All active members
repeat_all_active.description: Include in the recurrence the members added later.

delete_bill.name: Delete a bill
delete_bill.description: Moves a bill to the Cospend trash. Deleting a custom-split bill removes all its parts. If Cospend cannot be reached, the operation is queued and sent later.

whole_group.name: Whole group
whole_group.description: Delete every part of a custom-split bill (otherwise only the given one).

retry_queued.name: Retry queued operations
retry_queued.description: Puts blocked operations back in the queue and tries to send the queue now. Without an operation identifier, every blocked operation is retried.

operation_id.name: Operation identifier
operation_id.description: Identifier shown in the repair issue or in the sensor attributes. All blocked operations when empty.

force.name: Ignore conflicts
force.description: Apply the operation even if the bill was changed or deleted elsewhere in the meantime.

discard_queued.name: Discard a queued operation
discard_queued.description: Abandons a queued or blocked operation. Nothing already written to Cospend is undone.

operation_id.name: Operation identifier
operation_id.description: Identifier shown in the repair issue or in the sensor attributes.

add_member.name: Add a member
add_member.description: Adds a member to the project (maintainer access required).

active.name: Active
active.description: Active member (a disabled member stays in the history).

update_member.name: Edit a member
update_member.description: Renames a member, changes its weight or color, or enables / disables it.

new_name.name: New name
new_name.description: New name (leave empty to keep it).

active.name: Active
active.description: Active member (a disabled member stays in the history).

delete_member.name: Delete a member
delete_member.description: Deletes a member. If it has bills, Cospend disables it instead.

update_category.name: Edit a category
update_category.description: Changes a category's name, icon or color.

new_name.name: New name
new_name.description: New name (leave empty to keep it).

delete_category.name: Delete a category
delete_category.description: Deletes a category; its bills then have no category.

update_payment_mode.name: Edit a payment mode
update_payment_mode.description: Changes a payment mode's name, icon or color.

new_name.name: New name
new_name.description: New name (leave empty to keep it).

add_currency.name: Add a currency
add_currency.description: Adds a secondary currency with its exchange rate.

name.name: Code
name.description: Currency code or name (for example USD).

exchange_rate.name: Exchange rate
exchange_rate.description: Value of one unit of this currency in the project's main currency.

update_currency.name: Edit a currency
update_currency.description: Changes a currency's name or exchange rate.

new_name.name: New name
new_name.description: New name (leave empty to keep it).

exchange_rate.name: Exchange rate
exchange_rate.description: Value of one unit of this currency in the project's main currency.

project_not_found.message: Cospend project “{project}” was not found among the configured projects.

project_ambiguous.message: Several configured projects match “{project}”. Use the project identifier.

project_archived.message: Project “{project}” is archived and cannot be modified.

partial_write.message: The operation stopped halfway. Already done: bills {done}. Nothing was undone or retried. Error: {error}

auth_failed.message: Cospend rejected the credentials. Re-authenticate the integration.

forbidden.message: Cospend refused the operation: insufficient permissions on this project.

operation_not_found.message: No queued operation has the identifier “{operation}”.

needs_maintainer.message: Managing the members, categories, payment modes and currencies of project "{project}" requires maintainer access.

blocked_conflict.title: Cospend operation blocked: bill changed elsewhere
blocked_conflict.description: The queued operation “{title}” (project {project}) was not sent because the bill was changed or deleted on Cospend after you asked for it. Check the bill in Cospend, then call the cospend.retry_queued action with operation_id {operation_id} (add force: true to apply it anyway) or cospend.discard_queued to abandon it.

blocked_bill_missing.title: Cospend operation blocked: bill not found
blocked_bill_missing.description: The queued operation “{title}” (project {project}) targets bill {error}, which no longer exists on Cospend. Call cospend.discard_queued with operation_id {operation_id} to abandon it.

blocked_project_missing.title: Cospend operation blocked: project unavailable
blocked_project_missing.description: The queued operation “{title}” targets project {project}, which is no longer configured or accessible. Add the project back in the integration options, then call cospend.retry_queued, or call cospend.discard_queued with operation_id {operation_id}.

blocked_request_failed.title: Cospend operation blocked: request refused
blocked_request_failed.description: Cospend refused the queued operation “{title}” (project {project}): {error}. Fix the cause, then call cospend.retry_queued, or call cospend.discard_queued with operation_id {operation_id}.
